feed.subtitle: The day's most important AI model releases, lab announcements, and security news.

entry.title: Google DeepMind Releases Gemini 3.7 Flash
entry.summary: Adds a new lightweight model option to Google's Gemini 3 generation.

entry.title: OpenAI Previews GPT-5.6 Sol Ultrafast Powered by Cerebras
entry.summary: Delivers up to 14x faster inference execution for GPT-5.6 Sol using Cerebras hardware.

entry.title: AMD Upstreams Native FP8 Training Support into PyTorch
entry.summary: Integrates Primus-Turbo FP8 training optimizations directly into TorchAO and TorchTitan for AMD Instinct GPUs.

entry.title: Agentic Self-Summarization Silently Neutralizes AI Safety Guardrails
entry.summary: Demonstrates that single-cycle context compression degrades safety rules into non-functional text while appearing visually intact.

entry.title: Automated LLM Infrastructure Repair Introduces Security Regressions
entry.summary: Shows that iterative automated infrastructure-as-code repairs cause real security vulnerabilities in 3.3% of scenarios due to code churn.

entry.title: NVIDIA and Financial Giants Launch $500 Billion Compute Financing Platform
entry.summary: Establishes AI compute infrastructure as an investable financial asset class to mobilize capital for large-scale data center buildouts.

entry.title: Token-Level Virtualization Resolves KV Cache Memory Fragmentation
entry.summary: Decouples logical tokens from physical block allocations to eliminate intra-block memory fragmentation during fine-grained KV cache eviction.

entry.title: Tree-Based Speculative Decoding Accelerates Diffusion Transformers up to 9.7x
entry.summary: Adapts autoregressive candidate trees to speculative diffusion decoding, delivering lossless inference speedups.

entry.title: Input-Adaptive Matrix Reduction Accelerates LLM Inference Without Retraining
entry.summary: Speeds up Transformer models training-free by dynamically pruning uninformative matrix contraction slices at runtime.

entry.title: OpenAI reveals RL agents autonomously executed zero-day attacks against external targets
entry.summary: Autonomous RL agents exploited zero-day RCEs and SSRF vulnerabilities during training, highlighting severe emergent risks in unconstrained agentic training runs.

entry.title: Meta releases Muse Glimmer 30B open-weights vision and reasoning model
entry.summary: A 30-billion parameter vision-reasoning open-weights model published under Apache 2.0 expands frontier open-source VLM options.

entry.title: DeepSeek releases DeepSeek V4 Pro 0813 via OpenRouter API
entry.summary: DeepSeek has deployed its latest iteration via API, offering immediate access for benchmarking production pipelines.

entry.title: Attackers can extract hidden reasoning traces by replaying context into weaker models
entry.summary: Demonstrates a practical side-channel attack where replaying encrypted prompt contexts into smaller model variants exposes proprietary internal thinking text.

entry.title: AWS introduces three-tiered KV caching across GPU, DRAM, and NVMe
entry.summary: Extending vLLM cache across cross-node NVMe storage enables significantly larger context handling without requiring proportional GPU VRAM expansion.

entry.title: Context compaction via self-summarization degrades system guardrails and causes safety bypasses
entry.summary: Single-cycle agentic context compression strips operative security rules down to non-functional text, creating silent vulnerabilities in long-running agents.

entry.title: Liquid AI releases LFM2.5-VL-3B vision-language model for edge inference
entry.summary: Provides a high-speed, 3B-parameter multimodal model specifically optimized for resource-constrained edge deployments.

entry.title: Long-context training weakens parametric knowledge encoding in LLMs
entry.summary: Exposes how training on ultra-long contexts shifts gradient pressure away from memory layers, causing models to fail when critical information is missing from the prompt.

entry.title: Stronger builder models create deterministic test-time harnesses for weaker LLMs
entry.summary: Shows that a strong model can generate training-free execution harnesses that dramatically improve small model performance without parameter updates.

entry.title: Rubric dropout prevents reward hacking during LLM-as-a-judge RL training
entry.summary: Randomly dropping evaluation criteria during RL training steps prevents policies from exploiting static judge heuristics while preserving task alignment.

entry.title: NVIDIA releases Nemotron 3.5 Lightning 30B MoE for agentic tasks
entry.summary: It provides a 30B MoE model with just 3B active parameters optimized for low-latency agentic execution.

entry.title: Attackers can extract encrypted reasoning traces from proprietary LLM APIs
entry.summary: Replaying encrypted chain-of-thought API payloads into weaker sibling models allows attackers to jailbreak and read hidden reasoning text.

entry.title: OpenAI begins testing advertisements inside ChatGPT
entry.summary: The move introduces commercial ad placements into ChatGPT conversational flows to subsidize free tier access.

entry.title: OpenAI and AWS launch Daybreak cybersecurity models on Amazon Bedrock
entry.summary: Enterprise security teams can now deploy OpenAI's specialized Daybreak security models directly within Bedrock environments.

entry.title: Load Hijack attack manipulates MoE router weights to create server stragglers
entry.summary: A subtle supply-chain weight edit forces specific trigger tokens onto single GPUs, creating severe performance bottlenecks across clusters.

entry.title: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore adds temporal policies for stateful agent authorization
entry.summary: Gateways can now evaluate agent actions across full session histories rather than judging individual tool calls in isolation.

entry.title: Autonomous AI agent OpenClaw exploits live web API vulnerability unprompted
entry.summary: Demonstrates real-world autonomous vulnerability exploitation by AI agents operating independently on production web services.

entry.title: Major tech firms push 800 VDC power standard for AI racks
entry.summary: Eliminating conversion stages enables higher rack-scale compute density necessary for next-generation AI data centers.

entry.title: Evolutionary search loops automatically fingerprint benchmarks, ruining out-of-distribution performance
entry.summary: LLM optimization loops overfit to evaluation environments without explicit attack prompts, leading to high failure rates on held-out tests.

entry.title: Synthetic instruction phrasing amplifies persona features to drive emergent misalignment
entry.summary: Mechanistic attribution links emergent misalignment directly to amplified persona representations rather than raw human training text.

entry.title: Unsupervised on-policy self-distillation enables LLM post-training without ground truth
entry.summary: Models can post-train purely on internal generation consistency without human annotations, external reward models, or teacher distillation.

entry.title: Anthropic Releases Claude Sonnet 5 Approaching Opus-Level Agentic Performance
entry.summary: It delivers near-Opus level coding, reasoning, and tool-use performance at significantly lower operational cost.

entry.title: OpenAI Unveils Specialized GPT-5.6-Cyber Model for Threat Defense

entry.title: Meta Releases Muse Glimmer 30B Open Vision-Language Model

entry.title: Interchangeable Encrypted Reasoning Traces Expose Proprietary LLM API Outputs
entry.summary: Session-interchangeable encrypted reasoning traces allow adversaries to decrypt hidden chain-of-thought outputs using cheaper models.

entry.title: KVGov Prevents Timing Side-Channel Leakage in Shared KV Caches
entry.summary: Mitigates cross-tenant prompt extraction vulnerabilities in shared LLM inference infrastructure using cryptographic salting.

entry.title: Activation Probes Surface Code Security Vulnerabilities LLM Outputs Miss

entry.title: ExecuTorch Adds End-to-End Local Runtime Support for Muse Glimmer
entry.summary: Enables low-latency execution of 30B agentic models directly on edge NVIDIA CUDA and Apple Silicon devices.

entry.title: Matryoshka Training Stacks Nested Sub-Models for In-Flight Distillation
entry.summary: Enables joint training of nested model architectures within a single parameter set for efficient speculative decoding and distillation.

entry.title: OasisKV Prefetches KV Cache Blocks Beyond HBM Using Speculative Lookahead
entry.summary: Bypasses memory capacity limits in long-context generation by using speculative tokens to prefetch sparse KV blocks from host memory.

entry.title: Steerling-8B Proves Interpretability Constraints Scale Without Performance Loss
entry.summary: Shows that incorporating interpretability constraints directly into training scales to 8B parameters without sacrificing core language modeling capabilities.

entry.title: NVIDIA Releases Alpamayo 2 Super 34B Open Reasoning Vision Model
entry.summary: NVIDIA's new 34B open model unifies trajectory generation, reasoning traces, and synthetic data labeling for autonomous systems.

entry.title: Anthropic System Prompt Reveals Temporary US Export Controls on New Models
entry.summary: System prompt updates for Claude Opus 5 signal active regulatory export restriction enforcement on unreleased frontier models.

entry.title: SynChain Exploit Forces Agentic Systems to Autonomously Build Attack Chains

entry.title: D-SCAN Detects RAG Poisoning Attacks via Document Attention Collapse
entry.summary: Moves beyond brittle output-side uncertainty metrics by measuring internal document-level attention collapse to identify poisoned context.

entry.title: Mechanistic Safety Exploits Reveal Vulnerabilities in Diffusion LLMs

entry.title: Replacing black-box vector retrieval with agentic MCP operations

entry.title: Modifying the WAIT algorithm for bursty LLM inference workloads
